mitrasova-pos.title: Mitrasova POS
mitrasova-pos.summary: Offline-First Cashier System with Supplier Consignment Management, Multi-Branch Stock, Balance Sheet & General Ledger.
mitrasova-pos.description: Mitrasova POS is a next-generation smart point-of-sale software solution. Engineered for retail & wholesale operations with robust offline mode, supplier consignment tracking & revenue share, multi-branch stock sync, and integrated accounting modules (balance sheet, profit & loss, and general ledger).

features.title: Offline-First Mode & Auto-Sync
features.description: Cashiers process transactions seamlessly without internet interruptions, with automatic cloud sync when network reconnects.

features.title: Consignment & Supplier Revenue Share
features.description: Manage consigned inventory receipts, automated commission calculations, supplier return tracking, and periodic settlement payouts.

features.title: Accounting Module & General Ledger
features.description: Automated transaction journaling, trial balance sheets, General Ledger, profit & loss reports, and profit margin analytics.

features.title: Multi-Outlet Stock Sync & Thermal Printing
features.description: Monitor stock across dozens of branches, inter-warehouse transfers, Bluetooth/LAN thermal printing, and cashier shift management.

faqs.question: Does Mitrasova POS support consignment (titipan) inventory management?
faqs.answer: Yes! Mitrasova POS includes an integrated consignment module to track consignors/suppliers, automate sales revenue splits, monitor consignment stock, and generate supplier settlement invoices.

faqs.question: Can Mitrasova POS operate without an internet connection (Offline Mode)?
faqs.answer: Yes! Mitrasova POS is engineered with an Offline-First architecture. You can continue processing sales when offline, and all transaction data automatically syncs once connection is restored.

faqs.question: What financial reports are generated by Mitrasova POS accounting module?
faqs.answer: Mitrasova POS provides Balance Sheets, Profit & Loss Statements (P&L), General Ledger, Automated Sales & Purchase Journals, and Cash Flow Reports.

mitrasova-daya.title: Mitrasova Daya
mitrasova-daya.heroTagline: Enterprise HRIS, Automated Payroll & Geolocation Attendance Platform
mitrasova-daya.summary: Automated Payroll Calculation, Tax PPh 21, BPJS, Face-Recognition Attendance, & Enterprise Employee Leave Management.
mitrasova-daya.description: Mitrasova Daya empowers HR leaders and executives to manage their most valuable asset: human capital. Manage dynamic shift schedules, instant payslip generation with latest tax regulations, reimbursement claims, and objective KPI reviews.

features.title: Automated Payroll & Tax Calculation
features.description: Calculate thousands of employee salaries complete with tax deductions, health, and labor social security in just 1 click.

features.title: Mobile Attendance + GPS & Face Liveness
features.description: Prevent attendance fraud with AI face liveness detection and office geofencing perimeter.

features.title: Self-Service Employee Portal (ESS)
features.description: Employees can request time-off, leave, overtime, and download encrypted payslips directly from their smartphones.

features.title: Shift & Performance Review Engine
features.description: Flexible shift matrix management for retail/manufacturing and monthly KPI objective evaluation.

faqs.question: Does payroll calculation support the latest 2024+ progressive tax tiers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tax calculation algorithms in Mitrasova Daya are continuously updated with Ministry of Finance regulatory updates.

faqs.question: What is the maximum employee capacity supported?
faqs.answer: Mitrasova Daya is tested to handle 50,000+ active employees with bulk payslip generation in under 2 minutes.

mitrasova-nexus.title: Mitrasova Nexus
mitrasova-nexus.heroTagline: High-Availability Cloud Hosting, Managed VPS & Security
mitrasova-nexus.summary: High-Performance Cloud Hosting Infrastructure with 99.99% Uptime SLA, Multi-Layer DDoS Protection, & Server Auto-Scaling.
mitrasova-nexus.description: Mitrasova Nexus is an enterprise managed cloud infrastructure service engineered for mission-critical workloads. Powered by Tier-4 data centers in Jakarta and Singapore with ultra-low latency and multi-tier security shields.

features.title: 99.99% Guaranteed Uptime SLA
features.description: Redundant multi-zone architecture with financial refund SLA guarantees against downtime.

features.title: Advanced Anti-DDoS Mitigation
features.description: Automated defense against Layer 3, 4, and 7 attacks backed by a 2 Tbps scrubbing center.

features.title: Automated Daily Cloud Snapshot Backup
features.description: Encrypted daily backups to off-site locations with minute-level Disaster Recovery Point (RPO/RTO) options.

features.title: Kubernetes & Auto-Scaling Ready
features.description: Docker and Kubernetes containerization support to seamlessly absorb sudden traffic spikes without latency.

faqs.question: Where are Mitrasova Nexus physical data centers located?
faqs.answer: Our servers reside in Tier-4 Data Centers in Jakarta (Indonesia) and Equinix SG1 (Singapore) for optimal peering latency.

faqs.question: Is technical support available 24 hours?
faqs.answer: Yes, our Cloud Engineering team is on duty 24/7/365 with response SLAs under 15 minutes.

mitrasova-labs.title: Mitrasova Labs
mitrasova-labs.heroTagline: Custom Software Engineering, Web & Mobile Development
mitrasova-labs.summary: Custom Enterprise Web Application Engineering, Native Mobile Apps, Microservices Architecture, & API Integrations.
mitrasova-labs.description: Mitrasova Labs delivers dedicated software architects and senior engineers to build large-scale custom solutions for your enterprise. From modern microservices architecture and payment gateways to custom iOS/Android apps.

features.title: Modern Fullstack Architecture
features.description: Engineering applications using Next.js, Node.js/Go, React Native, PostgreSQL, and Cloud-Native stacks.

features.title: API & Legacy System Integration
features.description: Bridging legacy ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) with modern digital platforms via RESTful and GraphQL APIs.

features.title: Code Security Audit & Penetration Testing
features.description: Rigorous security vulnerability auditing based on OWASP Top 10 standards prior to production release.

features.title: Agile Development Sprint & SLA Support
features.description: Transparent weekly sprint progress with Scrum methodology, Swagger API documentation, and maintenance warranties.

faqs.question: What is the estimated delivery timeline for custom software projects?
faqs.answer: Depending on module scope. Medium MVP projects range from 4–8 weeks, while enterprise core systems span 12–24 weeks with staged agile sprints.

faqs.question: Does the client retain full ownership of the source code?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%. Upon project handover, all Intellectual Property (IP) and Source Code rights belong entirely to the client.
